Create Palettes for VIs in Folder.vi

Owning Palette: VI Helpeks API

The VI creates palette files for VIs in a folder. It creates a palette for every sub-folder and LLB beneath the given folder recursively.

Details

Click the parameters for details

 

Create palettes for LLBs. If TRUE, a palette is created for every LLB file found. Otherwise, VIs from an LLB are placed to the palette created for the parent folder. Default is FALSE.
Palette Icon specifies icon of the top-level palette. If Palette Icon is empty picture (by default), the icon is built same way as for sub-palettes (see details in VI description).
Palette File Path specifies path of the top-level palette file which should be created. If the path is empty (by default),  the palette file is created in the folder defined by Folder or LLB Path with the same name as the folder or LLB has (for LLB, palette is created in the parent folder).
Folder or LLB Path specifies a folder or LLB file for which the pallete is to be created.
Save sub-palettes in sub-folders (F). If TRUE, palettes are saved in the respective folders. Otherwise, all palettes are saved in the same folder as the top-level palette. Default is FALSE.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
Filter Options specifies files and folders that should be ignored while creating palettes. Exclusion patterns are the regular expression for the Match Pattern function. In order to define several patterns, separate them with the Line Feed (i.e. every line contains one pattern). Empty lines are ignored.
Exclude Dir Name pattern(s) is the regular expression that defines name pattern(s) for folder names. Use <LF> to separate several patterns.
Exclude LLB Name pattern(s) is the regular expression that defines name pattern(s) for LLB names. Use <LF> to separate several patterns.
Exclude VI Name pattern(s) is the regular expression that defines name pattern(s) for VI names. Use <LF> to separate several patterns.
Palette File Path out returns the path to the top-level palette file created.
All Palette File Paths returns the paths to all palette files created.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.

 

Create Palettes for VIs in Folder details

Palette icons
For the given folder and all sub-folders beneath it, the VI looks for an image file to use as an icon for the respective palette. A folder's icon file can be one of the following:
(1) A file with the same name as the folder and a .png extension that resides in the folder's parent directory.
(2) A file with the dir_icon.png name that resides inside the folder itself.
If neither of these icon files is found, a default icon is applied to the respective palette.

The icon of the top-level palette can be defined explicitly in the Palette Icon input terminal.
